div.div:
Resilience is operationalised as five indicator families surfaced by the deterministic seven-CSV contract.
Every indicator is expressed in SI units (GWh, EUR, EUR/MWh, MWh), reproducible from the same artefacts, and inter-comparable across scenarios, deployments and borders.
The recovery / absorption / adaptation triplet is therefore measured, not asserted.
